title: possum
description: Positron emission tomography (PET) simulation tool as part of FSL suite

mr_parameters.description: Input matrix filename containing MR parameters
mr_parameters.title: MR Parameters

motion_matrix.description: Input motion matrix filename (time(s) Tx(m) Ty(m) Tz(m) Rx(rad) Ry(rad) Rz(rad))
motion_matrix.title: Motion Matrix

pulse_sequence.description: Input matrix basename for pulse sequence files (.posx, .posy, etc.)
pulse_sequence.title: Pulse Sequence

rf_slice_profile.description: Input matrix filename containing RF slice profile
rf_slice_profile.title: RF Slice Profile

output_signal.description: Output matrix filename for the signal
output_signal.title: Output Signal

event_matrix.description: Main event matrix file [(t(s), rf_ang(rad), rf_freq_band(Hz), rf_cent_freq(Hz), ...)]
event_matrix.title: Main Event Matrix

b0_inhomogeneities.description: B0 inhomogeneities due to susceptibility differences (basename)
b0_inhomogeneities.title: B0 Inhomogeneities

extra_b0_inhomogeneities.description: B0 inhomogeneities due to an extra field
extra_b0_inhomogeneities.title: Extra B0 Inhomogeneities

level.description: Level of processing: 1.no motion//basic B0, 2.motion//basic B0, 3.motion//full B0, 4.no motion//time changing B0
level.title: Levels

num_procs.description: Number of processors available for parallelisation
num_procs.title: Number of Processors

no_speedup.description: If ON, will not do the speedup but perform signal calculation for all slices for each voxel
no_speedup.title: No Speedup

rf_average.description: If ON, it will use RF angle averaging
rf_average.title: RF Angle Averaging
